context: A teen student asks the teacher about effort and growth
purpose: Teach: とくに/きわめて/あくまで/どんなに/仮に/たいへん/だんだん/なぜなら

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、わたし、どんなに頑張っても成績が上がらないんです。
lines.en: Sensei, no matter how hard I try, my grades just won't go up.
lines.style: Discouraged teen voice trailing off, frustrated and a little teary

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうですか。とくに苦手な科目はありますか?
lines.en: I see. Is there a subject you find especially difficult?
lines.style: Calm teacherly ですます tone, gently probing with warmth

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 数学です。たいへん難しくて、見るだけで頭が痛くなります。
lines.en: Math. It's really tough, just looking at it gives me a headache.
lines.style: Exasperated teen groan, half-joking half-serious complaint

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: わかります。でも、だんだんできるようになるものですよ。
lines.en: I understand. But you'll gradually get better at it, you know.
lines.style: Reassuring teacher cadence, slow and patient delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 仮に毎日勉強したとしても、本当に伸びるんでしょうか?
lines.en: Even if I studied every day, would I really improve?
lines.style: Skeptical teen questioning, voice rising at the end uncertainly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伸びます。なぜなら、努力は必ず形になるからです。
lines.en: You will. Because effort always takes shape in the end.
lines.style: Firm encouraging declaration, teacherly conviction in every word

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あくまで自分のペースで、きわめて小さな一歩でいいんですよ。
lines.en: Strictly at your own pace, even an extremely small step is fine.
lines.style: Soft warm follow-up, lowering voice to comfort the student

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ……はい。ちょっとだけ、やってみます。
lines.en: ...Okay. I'll give it a little try.
lines.style: Quiet hesitant teen acceptance, small determined nod afterward
